Load the stats.ncaa.org to ESPN WBB crosswalks

Source: R/load_crosswalk.R
load_wbb_ncaa_espn_team_crosswalk.Rd

stats.ncaa.org gives a team a new numeric id every season and spells school names in AP style; ESPN keeps one id per school. These loaders read the all-seasons crosswalk tables on the wbb_crosswalk release tag that join the two, so the load_ncaa_wbb_*() tables can be matched to the ESPN-based load_wbb_*() tables.

  • load_wbb_ncaa_espn_team_crosswalk(): one row per season and stats.ncaa.org team id (2009-10 onward), with the ESPN team and both sources' conference for that season. The same table as sportsdataverse-py's ncaa_espn_team_crosswalk(league = "wbb").

  • load_wbb_ncaa_espn_schools(): one row per NCAA school (org id) with its ESPN team.

  • load_wbb_ncaa_espn_school_seasons(): one row per school, sport and season with that season's stats.ncaa.org team id. It covers both sports (sport is mbb or wbb), since an org id is shared by every team of a school.

The ESPN ids (espn_team_id, espn_conference_id) are returned as integer, matching the ESPN loaders; ncaa_team_id and ncaa_org_id are integer, as in load_ncaa_wbb_team_ids(). season is the "YYYY-YY" string the release uses.

Usage

load_wbb_ncaa_espn_team_crosswalk()

load_wbb_ncaa_espn_schools()

load_wbb_ncaa_espn_school_seasons()

Source

https://github.com/sportsdataverse/sportsdataverse-data/releases/tag/wbb_crosswalk

Value

load_wbb_ncaa_espn_team_crosswalk() returns a wehoop_data tibble:

col_nametypesdescription
seasoncharacterSeason, "YYYY-YY" (e.g. "2024-25").
ncaa_team_idintegerstats.ncaa.org team id for that season.
ncaa_org_idintegerstats.ncaa.org school (org) id, stable across seasons.
ncaa_teamcharacterstats.ncaa.org school name.
ncaa_conferencecharacterstats.ncaa.org conference that season.
conference_idcharacterSportsDataverse group id (e.g. wbb:big-ten).
espn_team_idintegerESPN team id.
espn_display_namecharacterESPN team display name.
espn_locationcharacterESPN team location.
espn_mascotcharacterESPN team mascot.
espn_abbreviationcharacterESPN team abbreviation.
espn_conference_namecharacterESPN conference name that season.
espn_conference_idintegerESPN conference (group) id that season.
match_methodcharacterHow the team was matched: exact, dict, alias, org or unmatched.

load_wbb_ncaa_espn_schools() returns ncaa_org_id, ncaa_team, espn_team_id and espn_display_name. load_wbb_ncaa_espn_school_seasons() returns ncaa_org_id, sport, season, ncaa_team_id and espn_team_id.

See also

Other WBB Crosswalk Functions: load_wnba_team_crosswalk(), wbb_player_crosswalk(), wbb_schedule_crosswalk(), wbb_team_crosswalk()
